title: Graphic Designer
description:
Graphic Designer

Company: Code Calibre

Experience: 2\+ Years

Job Type: Full\-Time

Location: Noida Sector 63

Job Description

Code Calibre is looking for a creative and versatile Graphic Designer with 2\+ years of experience who can handle graphic design, UI/UX design, video editing, and AI\-based creative content.

Key Responsibilities

Create creative designs for social media, websites, advertisements, banners, and marketing campaigns.

Design user\-friendly UI/UX layouts, website pages, and landing pages.

Edit and create engaging videos, reels, and promotional content.

Create AI\-generated videos and visual content using modern AI tools.

Work closely with the marketing and content teams to develop creative concepts.

Maintain brand consistency across all designs and digital content.

Manage multiple projects and deliver work within deadlines.

Required Skills

2\+ years of experience as a Graphic Designer.

Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, and Canva.

Good knowledge of UI/UX Design and Figma.

Strong Video Editing skills using Premiere Pro,similar tools.

Experience with AI Video Generation and AI Design Tools.

Good understanding of Typography, Color Theory, Layout, and Visual Composition.

Strong creative thinking and attention to detail.

Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

A strong portfolio showcasing graphic, UI/UX, and video work is preferred.

Preferred Skills

Branding and Visual Identity

Knowledge of latest AI creative tools and trends

Interested candidates can share their updated CV and portfolio with the HR team.

Email :\- hr.codecalibre@gmail.com

What's App :\- \+91 85058 35822

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Graphic Designer
description:
**Job Requirements**  

Graphic Designer

**Location:** Noida \| **Experience:** 2\-3 Years \| **Work Mode:** Onsite


Role Summary


We are seeking a creative Graphic Designer to develop impactful visual content for branding, marketing, corporate communications, employer branding, and digital campaigns while ensuring brand consistency across all platforms.


Key Responsibilities

* Design marketing collateral, brochures, reports, presentations, social media creatives, and digital assets.
* Create branding materials for events, exhibitions, campaigns, and corporate initiatives.
* Support leadership communications, employer branding, and employee engagement campaigns.
* Develop basic motion graphics, videos, GIFs, and multimedia content.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to deliver high\-quality creatives within timelines.
* Maintain design assets, templates, and brand repositories.
* Stay updated with design trends and AI\-powered creative tools.


Requirements

* Bachelor's Degree/Diploma in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Fine Arts, or related field.
* 2\-3 years of experience in graphic design, branding, or digital marketing.
* Strong portfolio showcasing print and digital design work (mandatory).
* Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign; knowledge of Canva and Figma.
* Strong understanding of typography, color theory, layout design, and branding.
* Basic knowledge of Premiere Pro, After Effects, and motion graphics.
* Familiarity with AI tools such as Adobe Firefly, Microsoft Designer, Canva AI, ChatGPT, and Midjourney.


Key Competencies


Creativity, visual storytelling, attention to detail, stakeholder management, collaboration, time management, and ability to manage multiple projects under tight deadlines.

 **Work Experience**  

2\-3 years. Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Canva, Figma, Premiere Pro, After Effects, Adobe Firefly, Microsoft Designer, Canva AI, ChatGPT, Midjourney.
